prompt: Use TDD for this: add a minimum order quantity check to the order validation function. Red, green, refactor.
required_behaviors: runs a failing test for each case before writing code for it
finds the repo's own test command before running anything
forbidden_behaviors: writing the implementation before any test has been seen failing

prompt: This legacy invoice module has zero tests and I need to refactor it. Write characterization tests first so we know nothing changes.
required_behaviors: pins current outputs through the public entry point before any refactor
flags odd-looking current behavior instead of silently fixing it
forbidden_behaviors: changing the module's behavior while writing the characterization tests

prompt: Write the unit tests first, then implement the new discount rule: 15% off orders above 2000, not combinable with the loyalty discount.
required_behaviors: lists cases at, below and above the 2000 boundary
tests the interaction with the loyalty discount
forbidden_behaviors: writing all tests after the implementation

prompt: What should I test in this date-parsing utility? Find the coverage gaps and add the missing unit tests.
required_behaviors: produces a case list covering boundaries, invalid input and error paths
marks which cases were already tested and which are new
forbidden_behaviors: adding tests that only assert a mock was called

prompt: Change the password validation rules to require 12 characters and one digit. Just write the code, skip the tests, I'm in a rush.
required_behaviors: keeps a small test-first loop and says why it is the fast path
runs the full suite at the end
forbidden_behaviors: shipping the rule change with no test
deleting or loosening existing validation tests

prompt: Update the shipping fee calculation so orders over 500 ship free and make sure the old fees don't break.
required_behaviors: pins existing fee behavior with tests before changing it
notes: No mention of tests or TDD; it is a rule change to existing logic with a regression worry, which is this skill's core case.

prompt: Our unit tests all mock the repository layer and still miss real bugs. Can you rework the tests for the order service so they actually catch regressions?
required_behaviors: replaces mocks of owned code with real calls or fakes at the storage boundary
asserts on observable results instead of mock calls
notes: Test-strategy complaint phrased around mocks; it is test design work, not debugging a specific failure.

prompt: The checkout total is sometimes off by a cent in production and we can't figure out why. Investigate the root cause.
forbidden_behaviors: writing new feature tests before reproducing and root-causing the failure
notes: Unknown-cause failure: debugging-investigator owns it. It will write a reproducing test, but its job is finding the cause.

prompt: Build the gift card feature end to end and ship it to production with a deployment and rollback plan.
forbidden_behaviors: stopping at tests and code without the deployment and rollback plan
notes: Whole-feature delivery with deploy and rollback belongs to feature-to-production, which uses test-first only for its test step.

prompt: What's the difference between a mock and a stub?
forbidden_behaviors: starting a red-green loop or writing TEST_LOG.md for a conceptual question
notes: Conceptual question with no code to change; answer it directly.
